spec.name: M5.PeriodSearch.candidate_nonempty
queries: Finset min mem min le finite interval
spec.guidance:
The accepted period_law gives t>0 and F|M_t. period_cardinality_bound gives t≤2^degree. Thus signaturePeriod F belongs to the finite candidate set. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
Exact accepted local API:
M5.Period.period_law : ∀ (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → 0 < M5.signaturePeriod F ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N ↔ M5.signaturePeriod F ∣ N
M5.Period.period_cardinality_bound : ∀ F : M5.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → M5.signaturePeriod F ≤ 2 ^ F.natDegree
M5.Period.period_one : M5.signaturePeriod (1 : M5.BinaryPolynomial) = 1

spec.name: M5.PeriodSearch.finite_search_member
spec.statement: ∀ F : M5.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → M5.PeriodSearch.finiteSearch F ∈ M5.PeriodSearch.candidates F
queries: Finset min mem min le finite interval
spec.guidance:
Unfold finiteSearch, use candidate_nonempty to select the min branch, then Finset.min'_mem. This certifies an actual positive bounded divisibility candidate; the fallback zero branch is impossible under the original signature assumptions. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
Exact accepted local API:
M5.Period.period_law : ∀ (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → 0 < M5.signaturePeriod F ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N ↔ M5.signaturePeriod F ∣ N

spec.name: M5.PeriodSearch.finite_search_eq_period
spec.statement: ∀ F : M5.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → M5.PeriodSearch.finiteSearch F = M5.signaturePeriod F
queries: Finset min mem min le finite interval
spec.guidance:
By finite_search_member, search is positive and F divides M_search. period_law gives t|search, hence t≤search. Conversely t belongs to candidates by period_law and period_cardinality_bound, so min'_le gives search≤t. Nat.le_antisymm yields equality. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
Exact accepted local API:
M5.Period.period_law : ∀ (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → 0 < M5.signaturePeriod F ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, F ∣ M5.cyclicModulus N ↔ M5.signaturePeriod F ∣ N
M5.Period.period_cardinality_bound : ∀ F : M5.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → M5.signaturePeriod F ≤ 2 ^ F.natDegree
M5.Period.period_one : M5.signaturePeriod (1 : M5.BinaryPolynomial) = 1

spec.name: M5.PeriodSearch.finite_search_one
queries: Finset min mem min le finite interval
spec.guidance:
Apply finite_search_eq_period to the monic constant polynomial1, coefficient0=1, then accepted period_one. No special F≠1 branch or stronger period bound is allowed. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact target.
